text:
daniel: Quick one — corporate card declined at a client dinner last night in SFO. Had to pay $182.45 on my personal card. Restaurant said card network flagged charge as high-risk. I have the receipt and the declined txn screenshot.

priya_finance: sorry that happened, @daniel. you can file for reimbursement but we need manager pre-approval for any corporate-card-decline > $100 per policy (https://policies.redwood.company/travel-per-diem). Can you attach the receipt + declined txn screenshot to the expense and ping your manager?

daniel: uploaded receipts to the expense app and set payment method = Personal Card. Also added note: "corp card declined at checkout; paid personally."

mike_manager: i approve reimbursement for this one-time incident. client meeting w/ Acme was scheduled; i'm signing off. mike_manager approval in expense app.

priya_finance: thanks @mike_manager. a couple of notes for @daniel: please split any alcohol items if they exceed the per-meal cap and mark non-reimbursable if it's personal entertainment. also attach a short justification: attendees + business purpose.

daniel: attendees: Mike, Sarah (product), and two Acme PMs. Business purpose: kickoff + scoping session. No alcohol above cap, full receipt attached.

priya_finance: great. I'll process this as an out-of-policy reimburse with manager exception. internal ticket created for audit trail. @opsbot can you log ticket?

opsbot: Ticket created: EXP-AUD-2026-77. Labels: corp-card-decline, manager-exception. Linked expense: EXP-2026-812.

priya_finance: ETA payout in next payroll cycle unless faster reimbursement requested. If you need expedited payment, DM me and we'll route through petty cash. :money_with_wings:

daniel: thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround.
